run_paq_generation_pipeline: run the PAQ generation pipeline to generate QA pairs from passage files using a config
combine_generated_files: combine passage scoring and filtered question files into final QA pairs output
run_passage_scoring: run passage scoring on input files and write scored passages to output directory
run_answer_extraction: run answer extraction on scored passages and write extracted answers to output directory
run_question_generation: run question generation on extracted answers and write generated questions to output directory
